scripts.quality:check: cd packages/simplebeacon-cli && npm test && node bin/simplebeacon.js scan --path ../.. --gate --offline
scripts.quality:monthly: cd packages/simplebeacon-cli && node bin/simplebeacon.js scan --path ../.. --gate --full --format json --output .simplebeacon/monthly-quality-report.json && npm audit && cd ../ai-platform && npm audit && cd ../coming-soon && npm audit
scripts.ai:check: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const files = execSync('git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM', {encoding:'utf8'}).split('\n').filter(f => f.match(/\.(js|cjs)$/)); let ok = true; files.forEach(f => { try { require('fs').accessSync(f); execSync('node -c "' + f + '"'); } catch(e) { console.error('Syntax error in', f); ok = false; } }); process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);"
